utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — it’s starting this Saturday morning at the community center, and they’re collecting tools, paint, and any small repair supplies. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess — that’s helpful. I’ll keep my plans flexible and wait for any more updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll pass along anything new as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late as usual, but I’ve got gloves and a basic tool kit—I’ll grab them and head over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the repair drive too and see what they need. If I hear anything useful, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll be there with the gloves and tools. If you catch any extra needs, just send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — I’m okay for now, but I may ask for help sorting donations later if that’s alright.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, Rey — just let me know when you’re ready, and I’ll help with the donations.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know when I’m ready.

utterances.text: Bo: Got it — what’s the next step you want me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching for any announced repair-drive location, so if you hear one, let me know and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana — the repair drive’s coming together nicely. If you’ve got any gloves or a couple basic tools, bring them along and we’ll put them to use.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — I’ll bring gloves and a couple basic tools. Just to confirm, are there any other items you’re collecting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect — if you have any spare screws, tape, or a flashlight, those would be great too. Otherwise, just bring what you’ve got and we’ll make it work.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, let’s confirm the accepted items first, then we can sort the donations by type.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — let’s keep the accepted items list front and center, then we can sort everything by type as it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll keep the accepted items list handy so we can sort everything correctly as donations come in.

utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard anything new yet, Gus, but I’m still out running errands and I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — no rush. If you hear any updates on the repair drive, just let me know when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll check back in as soon as I hear anything on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donated tools by size and set them out in the bins.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — that’s the main thing. Once they’re sorted, we can start checking what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll get them sorted right away so we can see what still needs to be found.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s the one — I just want to make sure we’ve got the details sorted before anything gets dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—what details still need sorting before the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mostly the time, the pickup spot, and who’s bringing what — I just don’t want anything getting missed on the day.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it starts this Saturday morning at the community center, and they’re collecting tools, paint, and small repair supplies. I’ll spread the word around the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll make a list of what we already have and what’s still missing. Thanks for spreading the word, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll let folks on my street know right away and point them to the community center this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I haven’t heard a repair-drive location announced yet, but I’m keeping an ear out. If you hear one, let me know and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — if you hear the location first, let me know and I’ll write it down too. I’ll keep checking what tools and screws we still need in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the location, and thanks for keeping an eye on the tools and screws.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send over the latest list and start lining up volunteers right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’m mostly getting bits and pieces, so I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything concrete I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep you posted as the list and volunteer slots come together.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
